main_text.p: fortes[?], quarum in iudiciis erat Athenis vsus, traiicere per κύαμον, id erat vrnæ operculum πλεκτὸν, κανισκωδες, pluribus descriptum nobis in animaduersionibus Athenaicis. Hesychius, Κίθιον, ὦ τὰς ψήφος διωδῶσιν ἐν ταῖς κληρωτηρίοις. ita scribendum ibi, non vt editum est κληρωτηρίοις. Hic vero ψήφος διωδεῖν positum pro calculis summatim rationes putare. Elegans translatio, & superbi hominis moribus conuenientissima. Adeo enim indignum se iudicat, sedere ad calculos, vt ne famulum quidem suum eos tractare velit, nisi negligenter & raptim.

καὶ τὸ κεφάλαιον ποιήσαι.) Puerum suum iubet imperiosus iste Manlius, in rationes referre summam quæ nascetur ex ipsius computo: alterius quicum rationes putat nullam habet rationem: si quid forte ille, vt ferè fit, quod opponat habet. Sic ista verba debent accipi.
main_text.head: Ad caput ὢ δειλίας.
main_text.p: Ἀμέλει ἡ δειλία δόξιν τῆ ὑπαξις τῆς ψυχῆς ἐμ-φοβ(ῶ). Planior est quæ habetur apud Andronicum definitio, Δειλία ἐστὶν ὑποχώρησις ἀπὸ φαινομένου καθήκοντος ἀπὸ φαντασίας δεινοῦ. Similes huic apud alios reperias. At in Platonis Ὅρος locus, qui definitionem δειλίας continet & corruptus est, & male à doctis acceptus: Eum nos in transcursu emendabimus, & exponemus. Ὅρος, ψυχῆς πόνων ἀρχῆς. Δειλία, ἀνιλαπτικὴ ὁρμῆς πρώτη τῆ ἐξ αἰτία. Docti corrigunt, Ὅρος, ψυχὴ πόνων. Ἀρχὴ, πρώτη τῆ ἐξ αἰτία. Δειλία ἀνιλαπτικὴ ὁρμῆς, quæ emendatio, si est à li-

page.notes: Greek passages are printed in small italic-like type and are copied as closely as the scan allows; the Greek in the heading and the second paragraph is doubtful in several places. "fortes" in the first line may be "sortes"; the scan reads "fortes". The large initial "Ἀ" of the second paragraph is joined to "μέλει". The word "ἐμ-φοβ(ῶ)" at the line end is partly unreadable and is best checked against the scan. The printed hyphen at the end of "li-" stays.
